audience: event organizers who sell tickets with Universe

useCases.title: See how many tickets each live event sold
useCases.text: List your events, or the events of a host account you manage. Ask the assistant for a summary of tickets sold per event.

useCases.title: Check which ticket types are almost sold out
useCases.text: List the ticket types of an event with price, capacity and sold count. Find the types that need a reminder or a new batch.

useCases.title: Track ticket sales per day
useCases.text: Read the ticket sales per day for an event between two dates. Ask the assistant to show the trend before and after a promotion.

useCases.title: Find who bought tickets for your next event
useCases.text: List the orders and the attendees of an event. Filter by order state or by name. Open one order to see the buyer and the check-in state.

useCases.title: Review the dates and time slots of an event
useCases.text: List the time slots of an event with capacity and tickets sold. Filter by a date range to see which dates still have room.
